description:
Suggest a price range for a place from local purchasing power and inflation.

    Public data has no competitor prices, so this adjusts a price you know (from elsewhere or
    an earlier date) to this place today: CPI for the category's group since that month, then
    local median income per consumption unit against the reference place. Returns a range
    from no local adjustment to full adjustment, labelled as an estimate.

category.description: Market category, to uprate with its own CPI group (e.g. 'gym', 'restaurant').
category.title: Category

place.description: Place name or INE code: municipality ('Valladolid' or '47186'), province ('41'; a bare name like 'Sevilla' means the city), autonomous community ('Cataluña' or 'CA09'), district ('4718603') or census tract ('4718603012'). 'Name, Province' picks between same-named towns.
place.title: Place

price_month.description: Month the reference price applied, YYYY-MM, to uprate it to today.
price_month.title: Price Month

reference_place.description: Where the reference price applies: 'ES' (Spain, default) or a place.
reference_place.title: Reference Place

reference_price.description: Price elsewhere, in euros, e.g. 39.9 for a monthly gym fee.
reference_price.title: Reference Price

name: price_band

area_names.description: For districts and tracts: OpenStreetMap neighbourhood names inside it (not official INE names).
area_names.title: Area Names

code.description: INE code. Pass this to other tools.
code.title: Code

match.description: How the query matched. 'fuzzy' means a spelling guess: confirm it. 'neighbourhood' means a neighbourhood name was found inside this INE district.
match.title: Match

matched_name.description: The neighbourhood name that matched, if any.
matched_name.title: Matched Name

official_name.description: INE's form of the name when it differs ('Palmas de Gran Canaria, Las').
official_name.title: Official Name

inflation_factor.description: CPI change from price_month to the latest month (1.0 if none).
inflation_factor.title: Inflation Factor

price_month.description: Month the reference price applied (YYYY-MM), if given.
price_month.title: Price Month

purchasing_power_index.description: Median income per consumption unit here / reference.
purchasing_power_index.title: Purchasing Power Index

Source.description: Where a figure comes from. Every number in `data` must trace to one of these.

data_period.description: Reference date or year of the data, e.g. '2025-01-01' or '2023'.
data_period.title: Data Period

dataset_id.description: Upstream identifier, e.g. INE table id '29005'.
dataset_id.title: Dataset Id

publisher.description: Organisation that publishes the data, e.g. 'INE'.
publisher.title: Publisher

retrieved_at.description: When this server fetched the data from upstream (UTC).
retrieved_at.title: Retrieved At

url.description: URL a person can open to see the data.
url.title: Url

Source.title: Source

confidence.description: Lowest confidence across inputs: high, medium or low. Never state a conclusion more strongly than this.
confidence.title: Confidence

title: Price range for a place
